description: Canonical list of specialist agents and scaffold skills. Single source of truth — when adding or changing specialists, edit only this file. Agents listed in `optInOnly` are not auto-included by orchestrators (e.g. `full_dev` requires `state.includeGenerativeMedia === true` to include `pn-generative-media-director`); they remain enumerable in `specialists[]` for UI and tooling.

optInOnly.pn-generative-media-director: Include only when state.includeGenerativeMedia === true (captured at the full_dev discovery step). When included, full_dev step 4 MUST call workflow_step('media_director', 0, {}) for the gated interactive flow.

onDemandAgents.pn-mobile-builder: Invoke manually for iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter work; not auto-routed by orchestrator.
onDemandAgents.pn-visionos-engineer: Invoke manually for Apple Vision Pro (visionOS) development; not auto-routed.
onDemandAgents.pn-webxr-developer: Invoke manually for browser-based WebXR/AR/VR; not auto-routed.
onDemandAgents.pn-cultural-researcher: Invoke manually for art history, movements, museum citations, period-accurate visual or copy grounding; not auto-routed.
onDemandAgents.pn-security-auditor: Invoke manually for dedicated security audit passes; not auto-routed (pn-reviewer calls pn-security-audit skill conditionally).
